zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi sgos dzap las/gtso bo yab yum ni/hūm̐ badz+ra dh+rik/mūṃ dhā twī shwa rī/rigs bzhi yab yum ni/oṃ dzi na dzik/lāṃ

tei:div.tei:p: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi sgos dzap las/ gtso bo yab yum ni/ hūm̐ badz+ra dh+rik /mūṃ dhā twī shwa rī/ rigs bzhi yab yum ni/ oṃ dzi na dzik /lāṃ dwe ṣa ra ti/ swā rat+na dh+rik /māṃ mo ha ra ti/ āṃ a ro lika /pāṃ rā gā ra ti/ hā pra dz+nyā dh+rik /tāṃ badz+ra ra ti/ sems dpa' yab yum brgyad ni/ k+ṣīṃ hi rā dza ya/ hūm̐ la sai sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ trāṃ ā gar+bha ya/ trāṃ mā le sa ma ya hoḥ hrī hā hūm̐ pad+ma pra da ma/ hrīṃ gīrti rā go haṃ/ dz+riṃ ku ru pā ṇi/ ā nīrti rā ga ya mye/ mai dhā ra ṇe swā hā/ dzaḥdhū pe pra be/ thiṃlha nis+sa raṃ bha ya swā hā/ hūm̐ puṣ+pe ā be sha /hūm̐ swa rā dzā ya swā hā/ baṃ dī pa su gi rī/ mūṃ shrī ā rā gā ya swā hā/ hoḥgan+dhe tsit+ta/ bya byed yab yum ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra tsit+ta oṃ/ a a a badz+rī bha dra sa man+ta āḥ thub pa drug ni/ oṃ mu ni kriṃ swā hā/ oṃ mu ne hūm̐ truṃ swā hā/ oṃ mu ne sruṃ swā hā/ oṃ mu ne breṃ swā hā/ oṃ mu ne k+ṣaṃ swā hā/ oṃ mu ne ye swā hā/ sgo ba yab yum ni/ hūm̐ ya mān+ta kṛta phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra dha ro ma hā kro dhe shwa rī dz+wa lī ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ pra dz+nyān+ta kṛta phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā rat+na dha ro ma hā kro dhe shwa rī dz+wa lī ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ pad+mān+ta kṛta phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā pad+ma dha ro ma hā kro dhe shwa rī dz+wa lī ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ bigh+nān+ta kṛta phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā karma dha ro ma hā kro dhe shwa rī dz+wa lī ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sgyu 'phrul zhi ba'i sgrub thabs ltar bris pa'o/ ༈ khrag 'thung nga brgyad kyi sgos dzap las/ gtso bo yab yum ni/ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka hūm̐/ badz+ra kro dhe shwa rī s+t+waṃ/ khrag 'thung rigs bzhi yab yum ni/ oṃ bud dha shrī he ru ka hūm̐/ bud dha kro dhi shwa rī s+t+waṃ/ oṃ rat+na shrī he ru ka hūm̐/ rat+na kro dhi shwa rī s+t+waṃ/

oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka hūm̐/ pad+ma kro dhi shwa rī s+t+waṃ/ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka hūm̐/ karma kro dhi shwa rī s+t+waṃ/ gnas ma brgyad ni/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī haḥ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī haḥ oṃ badz+ra pra mo he haḥ oṃ badz+ra be tā lī haḥ oṃ badz+ra puk+ka sī haḥ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī haḥ oṃ badz+ra sme sha nī haḥ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa lī haḥ yul ma brgyad ni/ oṃ badz+ra siṃ ha mu khī he/ oṃ badz+ra byā gh+ri mu khī he/ oṃ badz+ra shri gā la mu khī he/ oṃ badz+ra shwa na mu khī he/ oṃ badz+ra gri dhā mu khī he/ oṃ badz+ra kaṅka mu khī he/ oṃ badz+ra kā ka mu khī he/ oṃ badz+ra u lū kā mu khī he/ sgo ma bzhi ni/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ya te dza te nga dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra a mu khī hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra lo ka baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bhasmi pa la ya ba tu hoḥ dbang mo nyer brgyad ni/ ma nu rak+sha sī bh+yo/ brah+ma ṇī bh+yo/ rau trī bh+yo/ beṣ+ṇa bai bh+yo/ ku mā rī bh+yo/ in+d+ra ṇī bh+yo/ badz+ra piṅga lī bh+yo/ a mṛtaṃ bh+yo/ sau mya bh+yo/ daṇ+ḍa de bh+yo/ rak+ṣa sī bh+yo/ bak+ṣa sī bh+yo/ ra ti badz+ra bh+yo/ ru dhi ra māt+ta bh+yo/ e ka tsa ri ṇī bh+yo/ ma no ha ra bh+yo/ sid+dhi kaṃ bh+yo/ bā ya be bh+yo/ ma hā mā ra ṇa badz+ra bh+yo/ ag+nī bh+yo/ ba ra hī bh+yo/ tsa muṇ+ḍī bh+yo/ su ra nī bh+yo/ wa ru ṇī bh+yo/ badz+ra ma hā kā lī bh+yo/ badz+ra tsā ka la bh+yo/ badz+ra kum+bha kar+ṇa bh+yo/ badz+ra lam+bho dā ra bh+yo/ zhes sgyu 'phrul khro bo'i sgrub thabs ltar ro//
